notes: Play knowledge rewritten as executable actions. Every reference is checked against the generated level data by tools/gen_level_nuance.py.

nuance.claim: Boarding the plane ends the mission, so every other objective must be finished before approaching it.
nuance.because: Objective 3 is the level exit; unfinished objectives score as failed.

nuance.claim: The plane cannot be started without the ignition key, so the key is the first objective regardless of difficulty.
nuance.because: Objective 0 exists at every difficulty while the destruction objectives do not.

nuance.claim: The ignition key sits on a desk inside a building near the start with soldiers posted behind it, so the room is cleared before the pickup rather than after.
A drivable tank is parked past the main building; taking it makes the open runway survivable, since the level's threat is sustained fire across ground with no cover.
The tank does not fire shells until shells are selected; entering and pulling the trigger uses the wrong weapon.
The heavy gun emplacements are not clustered: one sits partway down the runway and the others at its far end, so they are cleared as a advance down the strip rather than a single stop.
nuance.because: Objective 1 names three separate destroy tags, and the guides place them at different points along the runway.

nuance.claim: The emplacements fire across the open runway from positions on the cliffs, so they are engaged from the tank or from cover rather than crossed on foot.
An explosive barrel sits beside the missile battery, so a single shot at the barrel destroys the battery without spending explosives.
Agent runs are key and escape only; the missile battery appears on Secret Agent and the gun emplacements on 00 Agent.
nuance.because: The ObjectiveStart records carry rising minimum difficulties for objectives 1 and 2.

nuance.claim: Finishing inside five minutes unlocks a cheat, which is the only reason to rush a level that otherwise rewards patience.
